days.title: High Summits and Settlements
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Geiersberg
stops.detail: The highest elevation at 586 m above sea level is the Geiersberg in the High Spessart.

stops.name: Geishöhe
stops.detail: The Geishöhe, officially Oberwintersbach (a district of Dammbach), is the highest settlement in the Spessart at an altitude of 521 m above sea level.

stops.name: Heinrichsthal
stops.detail: The village of Heinrichsthal in the North Spessart is the highest independent municipality in the Spessart at 436 m above sea level.

days.title: Southern Landmarks and History
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Mainviereck
stops.detail: The Mainviereck refers to the southern part of the Spessart with the four corner points Lohr, Wertheim, Miltenberg and Aschaffenburg.

stops.name: Michaelsberg
stops.detail: A hunting lodge is said to have stood on the Michaelsberg in Rorinlacha, today's Neustadt am Main, as early as 640.
